Examen de prueba del 3er trimestre

Temas: Places in town: there is / there are · Present continuous · Reading and writing a short story.

Nombre: ______________________   Fecha: ___________   Nota: ______

  1. «Hay un parque» is…

  2. «There ___ three schools.»

  3. «Library» means…

  4. «There aren't ___ museums.»

  5. Which question is correct?

  6. Short answer: «Are there any parks?» (no)

  7. «Opposite» means…

  8. «Between» means…

  9. «How many cinemas ___ there?»

  10. A very big town with an airport is a…

  11. I walk to school = I go to school…

  12. «Gira a la izquierda» is…

  13. The famous bell in London is…

  14. ___ were lots of horses.

  15. Was there a pool? No, there ___ .

  16. «There's» is the short form of…

  17. «There ___ a post office next to the bank.»

  18. «Panadería» is…

  19. «Is there a hospital?» (no)

  20. In the reading, what was in the main hall of the museum?

  21. Which bus could Carla and Dani take?

  22. We use the present continuous for…

  23. «I ___ reading.»

  24. «They ___ playing.»

  25. The -ing form of «swim» is…

  26. The -ing form of «write» is…

  27. «He ___ watching TV.» (negativa)

  28. «___ you listening?»

  29. «What are you doing?» means…

  30. Which sentence is present continuous?

  31. Which word goes with the present continuous?

  32. I ___ my homework every day.

  33. Is she sleeping? Yes, she ___ .

  34. «Al fondo» is…

  35. It's ___ . Take your raincoat.

  36. On the phone we say…

  37. «Look! The baby ___.»

  38. Short answer: «Is it raining?» (yes)

  39. The -ing form of «get» is…

  40. «I ___ to school every day.»

  41. In the reading, what is Leo wearing?

  42. Which verb is NOT used in the continuous?

  43. «Érase una vez» is…

  44. The characters are…

  45. The setting is…

  46. Which part has the problem?

  47. «Suddenly» means…

  48. «Brave» means…

  49. Which is a word to finish?

  50. «There was» means…

  51. In «The Little Cloud», Nimbo is…

  52. At the start of a sentence we use…

  53. The past of «take» is…

  54. A person who never wants to work is…

  55. The lesson of a fable is the…

  56. In English, dialogue goes in…

  57. «…and they lived happily ever after» is…

  58. «Then» and «after that» are…

  59. How does Nimbo solve the problem?

  60. «Lived» means…

  61. The end of a story…

  62. In the reading, how did the mouse help the lion?

  63. Who wrote The Lion and the Mouse?

Soluciones

  1. C) Uno: there is.
  2. A) Plural.
  3. B) Falso amigo.
  4. B) Negativa: any.
  5. C) Is there…?
  6. A) Plural.
  7. C) opposite.
  8. B) between.
  9. A) How many + are.
  10. A) city.
  11. B) Transport.
  12. C) Directions.
  13. B) London.
  14. A) There was / were.
  15. C) There was / were.
  16. B) There is.
  17. C) Uno.
  18. A) bakery.
  19. C) Singular.
  20. A) Reading.
  21. B) Reading.
  22. C) Ahora.
  23. A) I + am.
  24. B) They + are.
  25. B) Doble m.
  26. C) Se quita la e.
  27. A) is not.
  28. C) you + are.
  29. B) Ahora mismo.
  30. A) is + -ing.
  31. A) En este momento.
  32. B) Simple or continuous.
  33. C) Short answers.
  34. B) Positions.
  35. A) Weather.
  36. C) Phone.
  37. B) Ahora: is + -ing.
  38. C) Yes, it is.
  39. A) Doble t.
  40. C) Costumbre: present simple.
  41. A) Reading.
  42. B) Simple or continuous.
  43. C) Fórmula de inicio.
  44. A) Personajes.
  45. B) Escenario.
  46. B) Nudo.
  47. C) Sorpresa.
  48. A) brave.
  49. C) Final.
  50. B) Pasado.
  51. A) Tímido.
  52. A) Mayúscula.
  53. B) Irregular verbs.
  54. C) Characters.
  55. B) Fables.
  56. A) Dialogue.
  57. C) Starters and endings.
  58. B) Conectores.
  59. C) Lluvia suave.
  60. A) lived.
  61. C) Desenlace.
  62. A) Reading.
  63. B) Fables.
